In the preregistered toy, a conservative hybrid closure rejected all six potentially execution-affecting successor changes while still certifying the unrelated documentation change.

A future F2 runtime-subject invariance witness should combine declared and observed dependency evidence with selector/config/environment/runtime-tool/discovery identities and an explicit dependency-completeness class; unknown completeness must invalidate or defer.
